official_instruction: Put the three cans of soda from the living room inside the trash can in the kitchen.
strategy_provenance: Evaluation vocabulary derived only from the official instruction: three distinct soda cans, each picked and placed inside the same kitchen trash can. A/B/C label different required items, not simulator IDs or known locations. Jev chooses the order of these item transports and left/right hand; the executor supports one carried object at a time. Neither task text nor planning asserts current visibility or success.

slots.target: soda can A: one of the three living-room cans not yet put in the kitchen trash
slots.done_when: the selected can follows the chosen hand during a measured verification lift

slots.target: the interior of the kitchen trash can, shared destination for all three cans
slots.done_when: can A is released inside the trash can and remains visibly supported there

slots.target: soda can B: a different one of the three living-room cans, not A and not already in the trash
slots.done_when: the distinct selected can follows the chosen hand during a measured verification lift

slots.target: the interior of the same kitchen trash can used for the other soda cans
slots.done_when: can B is released inside the shared trash can and remains visibly supported there

slots.target: soda can C: the third distinct living-room can, not A or B and not already in the trash
slots.done_when: the third distinct selected can follows the chosen hand during a measured verification lift

slots.target: the interior of the same kitchen trash can used for the other soda cans
slots.done_when: can C is released inside the shared trash can and remains visibly supported there
